decisions.briefing: Markets were modestly risk-on today with NASDAQ +1.2% and S&P 500 +1.0%. With $589 in cash and 3 open slots, we deployed into MWH (full multi-signal confirmation including a volume surge) and DELL (a steadier large-cap tech name) while leaving one slot open and holding all existing positions.

market_education.summary_en: Broad market gains today were led by technology and momentum names, with NASDAQ outpacing the S&P 500, suggesting continued risk appetite among investors. No specific catalyst headlines were provided for today, so the move appears consistent with ongoing sector-level buying interest rather than a single news event. Breadth across many bullish-momentum stocks on the screener supports a genuine, broad-based risk-on tone rather than an isolated rally.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市普遍上升，科技股及具動能股份表現領先，納指升幅跑贏標普500指數，反映投資者風險胃納持續。今日並未有提供具體新聞觸發因素，故此次上揚較似是板塊性資金流入所致，而非單一新聞事件推動。從篩選名單中大量股份呈現看漲動能信號可見，今次上升屬較廣泛的風險偏好，而非個別股份的孤立反彈。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Volume confirmation means checking that a price move is backed by higher-than-normal trading volume, which suggests real institutional participation rather than a random blip. Today's top buy candidate stood out because it combined bullish RSI, a MACD crossover, and price above its moving average with a volume surge — all four signals together give much more confidence than any single signal alone.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「成交量確認」是指留意股價升跌是否伴隨高於正常水平的成交量，這顯示背後可能有機構投資者真實參與，而非偶然波動。今日表現最突出的候選股份同時符合RSI看漲、MACD黃金交叉、股價高於移動平均線，並出現成交量急增——四個信號同時出現，遠比單一信號更具說服力。
